biography.value: Shades are the most basic expression of the Shadow Plane's predatory nature; a barely-manifested hunger that drains strength through contact. Their combat capability is minimal against anything that fights back effectively, but Strength Drain accumulates across hits in a way that compounds. Shadow Form in darkness makes them genuinely difficult to put down through mundane means.

system.attacksNotes:
Strength Drain [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 6 + Melee Combat 1), Reach: 5 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 5 Negative damage (4 + 1 Str); target's Strength reduced by 1 for 1 hour.
  • Margin 2: 5 Negative damage, DR halved (round up); Strength reduced by 2 for 1 hour; target gains Weakened condition.
  • Margin 3: 5 Negative damage, DR halved (round up); Strength reduced by 3 for 1 hour; Weakened; target makes Fortitude [Easy] save or movement speed reduced by 10 until Strength restores.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Amorphous: Can move through spaces as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing. Shadow Form: While in dim light or darkness, DR increases to 6 against all non-magical damage and non-Positive energy damage. Positive energy ignores this entirely. Shadow Spawn: If a non-undead creature is killed while their Strength has been reduced to 0 by the Shade's ### Attacks, a new Shade rises from their shadow at the start of the next round. This new Shade is not under the summoner's control — it is a free Shadow creature that has just arrived on the prime material through the death. The summoner's Summoning Limit does not apply to it.
